'''Yudin Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], House Thul was invaded by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. Yudin Thul believed that these creatures could be driven back, so he went to search for answers. In [[3642 BBY]], he eventually discovered that Killik relics from a nearby ruin could hold important historical information that will help in defeating these natives. After sending a team of researchers to retrieve the relics, Yudin saw that they hadn't returned. He later tasked an Imperial spacer to reach the relics from the [[Anzaada Cavern]].
